name: web-orlina-fashion-hero-introducing-with-model-and-product-cards
title: Orlina fashion 'Introducing' hero: a model in a leather coat over a giant serif wordmark with floating product cards
whatItIs: A blurred warm background with a grey rounded panel reading 'Introducing' and a giant faint 'Orlina' serif, a cut-out model in a brown leather coat and sunglasses standing in front, floating product and category cards (Man, Women, Kids), 'Trending Now' filter pills and a circular text badge.
whatItMeans: Luxurious and editorial; the model breaks out of the panel like a magazine cover.
techniques: Let a cut-out model break out of the content panel.
Set a giant faint serif wordmark behind.
Float small product cards at different depths.

vocabulary.definition: An element extending beyond its container.
Shopping design that borrows magazine style.
